in_marathi.name: Yagnavalkya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sacrificial Fire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yagnavalkya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yagnavalkya is a revered sage in Hindu mythology, known for his profound wisdom and knowledge of Vedic rituals.
